projects.name: AudioCast
projects.summary: AudioCast is a novel "Beyond-Backscatter" transmitter utilizing tunnel diode oscillators to enable microwatt-scale, long-range communication compatible with commodity receivers.

projects.name: PixelGen
projects.summary: PixelGen is a distributed low-power embedded AI camera system for mixed-reality that leverages generative AI to reconstruct high-fidelity environments from low-resolution, multi-modal sensor data.
